items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So, one of the other ones, I think it was Ambrose, he must have saw it, you know.

ctx.x: Trunk, that's it. Thank you, mam. So, I thought maybe it was a big flying insect or something, you know, so I done like that, you know, little hand and slapped it, you know. And it made a funny sound like that, you know. So, I felt some kind of steam or something going away from it, and I jumped up the road, you know. So, one of the other ones, I think it was Ambrose, he must have saw it, you know. He said, "What is that?" you know. "What is that thing? It's moving!" You know. So, most of the others, see, that's…

you see. So, the keeper called all them in and he says, "Don't be afraid," you know, he says, "She wouldn't harm you. She's thought you was her baby or something," he says, or "She wants her baby," or something he says. He says, "Can you kind of tip-toe where she wouldn't hear? She can hear -- she's got very -- she can hear so sharply. Could you do something to -- don't let her think that you don't like her or something," you (laughter) act like you would if you was-- (unintelligible) know. So, now, I'm trying to…
